card.title: Choose What Matters More
card.instruction: Make someone choose between emotional safety and the outcome they claim to want.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before we renew this lease, do you want my honest answer about living together or a peaceful dinner?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Your honest answer. Just don't say anything that makes me panic.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can't promise both. Shall I answer, or shall we order?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Answer. But start by saying we're fine.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's the answer you're choosing for me. Do you still want mine?

mechanism: A makes B choose between a real answer about living together and the reassurance B tries to prescribe.
confusable: Unlike merely refusing to comfort, A must show that guaranteed safety changes the requested outcome itself.
comparison: D106-b exposes a dictated opening as chosen content; D106-a exposes no-laughter reassurance as incompatible with an honest audition risk.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
